plan.title: Direct eRFX RFQ award to PO

steps.note: Open the direct eRFX project creation flow.
Set the required project title from the case.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before applying its template and configuring its sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Verify that the RFQ stage has a template applied.
Add one CYLINDER line item with the required quantity.
Enter the requested delivery location in the line-item sheet.
Verify that the delivery location was retained.
Confirm the project contains exactly one line item.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Commit the 30-minute start-now schedule.
Invite two QA vendors for the two required bids.
Publish the RFQ event.
Verify that the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor's quote at 100.
Verify that the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's quote at 90.
Verify that the second vendor bid was accepted.
Confirm that the buyer sees two direct vendor responses from both invited vendors.
Close the published bidding window before awarding.
Open Master QCS to compare the two submitted bids.
Verify that two real vendor columns are present.
Verify that the lower-priced bid ranks better.
Award the entire event to the lowest bidder, corresponding to the 90 quote.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award as the buyer-side approver.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Verify that one PO contains the full quantity of the awarded line item.
Verify that Recreate Order remains available for this direct event.
Return to the events list to verify the post-award location.
Open the History tab after completion.
Verify that the created event appears in History.
Verify the completed event's history status.
